facts.fact: Portal de TI reports that Angola's Proposta de Lei sobre a Inteligência Artificial is in public consultation, and that the country has no AI-specific legislation yet.
facts.system: Proposta de Lei sobre a Inteligência Artificial

facts.fact: APD legal director Njunjulo António says the right not to be subject to automated decisions already exists and that the agency's inspection and audit of AI use rests on data-processing principles of transparency, purpose and lawfulness.
facts.system: Right not to be subject to automated decisions

note: APD reports no AI-related data breach case to date, so no enforcement is recorded.
